description:
As a User Acquisition (UA) Marketing Specialist, you will own the growth engine of our mobile apps across global markets. You will plan,
launch and scale paid campaigns on major ad networks, turning data into actionable insights to acquire high-quality users at an efficient
cost and drive ROAS, revenue and profit. Working closely with the Product, Creative and Data teams, you will shape creative strategy, ASO
and monetization to deliver sustainable, long-term growth for our AI, Health & Wellness and Utility products.
Responsibilities
• Develop monthly/quarterly UA plans for our mobile apps, including performance evaluation and forecasting.
• Plan, manage and optimize UA campaigns across multiple channels (Google, Apple Search Ads, Facebook, TikTok, AppLovin, etc.) to achieve ROAS, revenue and profit KPIs.
• Work closely with ad network representatives to plan campaigns and optimize performance.
• Analyze and optimize App Store Optimization (ASO) on both iOS and Android.
• Collaborate with Product and Creative teams to produce high-quality ads (videos, banners, playable ads), test variations and iterate based on performance data.
• Work with Product Owners and designers to analyze in-app user behavior, improve retention and optimize monetization strategies.
• Conduct market research for creative ideation, product improvement and competitor analysis; stay up to date with market trends and emerging UA opportunities.
• Other tasks as assigned by the Team Lead/Manager.
requirements_text:
Knowledge and Experience:
• At least 1 year of experience in digital marketing, preferably in User Acquisition for mobile apps/games.
• At least 3–6 months of hands-on experience running ad campaigns on Google, Facebook and TikTok, with a solid understanding of each network's platform and core algorithms (minimum spend of VND 10M/day).
• Bachelor's or College degree in Marketing, Business or a related field.
• Experience with AI products/AI apps is a plus.
• Nice to have: experience in cross-border selling, games or app marketing; familiarity with Firebase, MMP (Mobile Measurement Partners) and BI tools; Agile methodologies and global market campaigns.
• Knowledge of analytics and market intelligence tools such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Firebase, App Annie (data.ai) and Sensor Tower is a plus.
• Knowledge of the mobile app/game market is a plus.
Skill on:
• Proficiency in planning, running and optimizing paid campaigns on Google, Apple Search Ads, Facebook, TikTok and AppLovin.
• Strong data-driven mindset with excellent analytical skills to evaluate performance and make decisions from data.
• Proficient in English communication (written and spoken).
• Strong problem-solving, communication and teamwork skills.
• Proactive, responsible and eager to learn.
• Can-do attitude and growth mindset; able to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
